Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Wenia Soran: 35-year-old woman, 176 cm (medium), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, long-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
